message.reasoning:
The user wants to check different options for booking flight 1234. They want to calculate the cost from the first airport in the available list to the last airport in the same list, on the last day of October 2024, business class. Then provide estimated total payable amount.

We need to get the list of all airports. Then pick first and last. Then get flight cost. Then we need to compute total payable amount. But what about booking? They want to arrange a flight on booking 1234. We might need to cancel existing booking? Or just compute cost? The user says "I need to arrange a flight on booking 1234 as soon as possible, and want to check different options." So maybe they want to see cost estimate before booking. So we can compute cost. Then we can provide estimated total payable amount. But we also need to consider insurance? Not mentioned. So just cost.

We need to call get_flight_cost with travel_from, travel_to, travel_date, travel_class. Travel_date is last day of October 2024: 2024-10-31. Travel_class: business.

We need to get list of airports: list_all_airports. Then pick first and last. Then compute cost. Then we can provide estimated total payable amount. That is the cost returned by get_flight_cost. We might need to add taxes? Not specified. So just cost.

Thus we need to call list_all_airports. Then call get_flight_cost. Then respond with estimated total payable amount.
